browser_original_visit_evidence.checked_in_my_turn: No production browser-monitoring product was checked for preserving rich evidence from the same original anomalous page visit. WebREC is a research measurement/archive system for browser executions, not a monitoring product; it was checked as a scholarly comparator. Vesper is a two-pass browser instrumentation research tool, not a longitudinal monitoring product.
browser_original_visit_evidence.root_cross_reference_not_independently_c: Root independently read Sentry's 2024 Browser Profiling Learnings primary blog and should cite it separately if using that evidence.
browser_original_visit_evidence.novelty_implication: Hindsight is the strongest original-event trace-retention comparator, but it targets distributed request traces; evidence for browser-session same-visit retention from products remains outside this agent's access receipt.
